In the year 2017 three colleges take admission for MBA in three branches. The following table represents the number of boys taking admission to three colleges. The total number of students is 15000. The number of students taking admission in college B was 36% and in college, C was 4600.

• The number of girls in the branch IB in college A was the same as the number of boys in the branch IT in college C.

• The total number of girls in branch HRM, B and IT was 2050, 2200 and 2450 respectively.

• The number of girls in branch IT in college B and the number of girls in branch IB in college C were the same.

• The ratio of the number of girls in college C in HRM and IB is 5 : 4.

What was the ratio of the number of students in branch IB in college C to the number of students in college B in the same branch?
